audit_metadata.title: Veritas Strict Experimental Audit and Abstract Claim Verification Manifest

audit_summary.description: Comprehensive senior research engineer audit report covering all 8 phases, executive summary, findings, and recommendations.

claim_evidence_matrix.description: Structured matrix mapping claims C1 through C11 to exact files, tests, commands, dataset sizes, expected vs actual results, and audit verdicts.

benchmark_reproducibility.description: Detailed recalculation and reproducibility verification for the 301-query baseline and expanded 922-query characterization benchmark.

temporal_security_test_report.description: Adversarial audit report evaluating temporal intervals, superseded policies, cross-role RBAC leaks, cache pollution, and audit trail fidelity.

grounding_abstention_report.description: Formal NLI verification report covering supported, contradictory, insufficient, and cross-version policy evidence cases.

abstract_review.description: Line-by-line editorial audit of the research paper abstract with recommended redlines, qualified claims, and camera-ready revisions.

artifact_manifest.description: Machine-readable provenance index linking audit outputs to source files, benchmark artifacts, and execution commands.

execution_commands.database_seeding: docker compose exec -T web python scripts/seed_enterprise_policies.py
execution_commands.route_audit: docker compose exec -T web python scripts/audit_all_views.py
execution_commands.policy_lifecycle_test: docker compose exec -T web python scripts/test_policy_creation_lifecycle.py
execution_commands.core_regression_tests: docker compose exec -T web pytest tests/test_rag_pipeline.py tests/test_rbac.py tests/test_whatif_ai.py tests/test_whatif_branches.py tests/test_hardening_regression.py -q
execution_commands.adversarial_audit_tests: docker compose exec -T web pytest tests/test_audit_adversarial.py -v
execution_commands.grounding_eval_script: docker compose exec -T web python scripts/audit_grounding_eval.py
